[p. scan0003] The
Zoology of the Talmud.

A comprehensive presentation
of rabbinic zoology, with constant comparison
of the researches of older and more recent writers

Dr. L. Lewysohn,
Preacher of the Israelite Congregation of Worms.

Published by the author.
On commission with Joseph Baer in Frankfurt am Main.
1858.

[p. scan0005] To his eldest brother
Abraham Lewysohn
in Peiskretscham, Upper Silesia,
(author of the work: Mekore Minhagim, Berlin 1846)

to his elder brother
Salomon Lewysohn
in Posen,
(author of the treatise: Chibbat Jeruschelajim we-Ahabat Zion, Wollstein 5615)
this book is dedicated as a token of the most heartfelt love
